title: Tax Associate
summary: A tax associate prepares and files a business's or client's direct and indirect tax work: income tax returns, TDS returns and GST (goods and services tax) returns, with the reconciliations behind them. You sit in a CA firm's tax team or a company's finance team, reporting to a tax manager and helping with tax audits and replies to tax notices.
dailyDuties: File GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B returns and track due dates
Reconcile GSTR-2B input credit with the purchase register
Prepare and file quarterly TDS returns
Compute income tax and advance tax and file returns
Prepare schedules for the tax audit report
Draft replies to GST and income tax notices
Coordinate with clients and auditors on data requests

skills.expectation: Compute income tax and advance tax and prepare and file income tax returns
Prepare and file GST returns (GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, GSTR-9) and TDS returns on time
Reconcile GSTR-2B with books and 26AS with TDS records and chase mismatches
Draft replies to tax notices and support assessments and appeals
Prepare tax audit schedules and support tax and statutory audits
Build tax computations and reconciliations in Excel
Write clear notes to clients and explain tax positions to finance teams
Help prepare transfer pricing documentation and Form 3CEB
Read the books well enough to tie tax numbers to the accounts
Pull ledgers and GST reports from Tally or a similar package
Extract tax data from SAP in corporate tax teams
Coordinate with clients, consultants and tax authorities
